The approvals inbox search now finds a request by what its row shows. The record title, process label, requester name and object label are each resolved the way this caller is served them, then matched as machine values. A title the caller cannot read (masked or unreadable field) still finds nothing. Failures and unresolved labels only narrow. Carry-overs, noted not filed (L1 nits):
- N1: labels are searched over the newest 5,000 requests of the scope (a warn is logged past that). A follow-up card is worth filing if a tenant reaches it.
- N4: matching stays case-sensitive, like the machine arms.
- A deleted record's snapshot-only title is not searched.
